name: Dolly Parton
title: Dolly Parton speaking to the crowd at the grand opening of Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop in Cornersville, Tennessee, on June 24, 2026, her last public appearance.
description: This photograph comes from a series taken on June 24, 2026, at the grand opening of Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop, her own truck stop off Interstate 65 in Cornersville, Tennessee. It shows Parton at the microphone, addressing the crowd. The last frame of the series is likely Plate 02, which shows her being escorted out after her remarks. The opening was her final public appearance. In May she had said she was responding well to treatment for health problems, and in an interview with People in August she spoke of having "hard times" with her health. On August 21, 2026, she was admitted to the Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville. She died of cancer four days later, on August 25. She was 80 years old.

lyrics.text:
Your beauty is beyond compare
With flaming locks of auburn hair
With ivory skin and eyes of emerald green
Your smile is like a breath of spring
Your voice is soft like summer rain
And I cannot compete with you, Jolene

bio: Dolly Parton was an American singer, songwriter, and actress. Known as the "Queen of Country", she was one of the most successful performers in country music history. Raised in the Smoky Mountains of East Tennessee, she released her debut album Hello, I'm Dolly in 1967. She wrote more than 3,000 songs, among them "Jolene", "Coat of Many Colors", "I Will Always Love You", and "9 to 5", sold more than a hundred million records, and won eleven Grammy Awards. She was inducted into the Country Music Hall of Fame in 1999. More on her life is at Wikipedia.
additionalImagesNote: Plate 02: Parton is escorted out after addressing the crowd, likely the last photograph of her in public. Plate 03: Parton cutting the ribbon with a jeweled pair of scissors. Plate 04: Parton addressing the crowd at the grand opening.
